description: This file defines options and validation logic for MemoryGrainStorage in Orleans, including configuration parameters like number of storage grains and initialization stage, as well as a validator class for these options.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorageOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for Orleans' MemoryGrainStorage, including the number of storage grains, init stage, and serializer.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorageOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the MemoryGrainStorageOptions instance to ensure configuration correctness.

methods.name: MemoryGrainStorageOptionsValidator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the validator with options and name.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Performs validation checks on the provided options, throwing exceptions if invalid.
